## Checklist

- [ ] `swift test` passes.

- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests where practical.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, screenshots, and receipts contain no private URLs, cookies, credentials, or personal paths.
- [ ] User-facing behavior, privacy, architecture, and changelog documentation are updated when affected.
- [ ] No production dependency, public API, signing policy, or release configuration changed without explicit review.
